description: An expander for the Tape Recorder that draws what is on the tape as a waveform, with the bar and beat lines and the loop range marked

params.text: Sets how much tape the display covers; the setting is raised to the sixteenth power, so most of the travel is in the close-up end
Scales the height of the waveform, from half to one and a half times

notes: it goes immediately to the right of a Tape Recorder and shows that recorder's tape. With any other module on its left, or none, the display stays empty.
the display is drawn by the module and carries no controls; it cannot be clicked or dragged.
